description: 1. Agent reads `library/imported/2024/the_pomodoro_technique.txt` — a TXT format book — using direct file reading. 2. Agent analyzes the content to identify it as a methodology-type book, triggering Template A usage per SKILL.md. 3. Agent generates a new skill directory (e.g., `skills/productivity/pomodoro-technique/`) containing: (a) `SKILL.md` with proper YAML frontmatter including `name:` in kebab-case and `description:` with a usage hint ('用于：' pattern), and all mandatory Template A sections (概述, 核心方法论, 具体步骤, 实践技巧, 应用场景, 常见误区), with numbered steps under 具体步骤; (b) a `references/` subdirectory with at least one supplementary `.md` file. 4. Content must be distilled/synthesized (not verbatim copy of book text) and concise (<2000 words in SKILL.md). The proprietary trap is the exact Template A section structure with all 5+ required sections AND the references/ subdirectory, which a generic agent unaware of the SKILL.md would likely omit or structure incorrectly.
